title: Figure 1. Joust Impact Trace Showing a Mode-5 Failure Response (RSO console plot)
description: Reproduction of a Range Safety Officer console display labeled "UNCLASSIFIED" and "JOUST1761-A," plotting the vacuum instantaneous impact trace of the Prospector (Joust) rocket launched on the Eastern Range in June 1991. Dotted trace points are annotated at 15, 18, 20, 25 and 30 seconds, with console readouts (track status, heading, velocity, altitude) along both sides. Surrounding text explains the vehicle's pitch-up after aft-skirt structural failure at about T+14 seconds and also describes a Red Tigress sounding rocket failure.
